Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

Indian Standard 

SPECIFICATION FOR 
BOBBINS FOR SEWING MACHINES WITH 
ROTATING HOOKS FOR INDUSTRIAL USE 



( Reaffirmed 2006 )

1. Scope — Covers the requirements for bobbins for sewing machines with rotating hooks for 
industrial use. 



2. Dimensions 




All dimensions in millimetres. 



0.07 



r <t>7.5 




KEY SLOTS 



8.5*0.2 



-0.2 



3. Material— The bobbins shall be manufactured from any suitable steel such as C15 of 
Schedule II of IS: 1570-1961 'Schedules for wrought steels for general engineering purposes 1 
or St34 conforming to IS: 1079-1973 'Specification for hot rolled carbon steel sheet and strip 
( third revision ) \ 

4. Accuracy Requirements 

4.1 Eccentricity of outer diameter with respect to inner diameter shall be within 0*2 mm of total 
indicator reading. 

4.2 The error in squareness of the flange with respect to the bore shall be within 0-2 mm per 100 mm. 

5. Tolerances — Tolerances on untoleranced dimension shall be medium class in accordance with 
IS : 2102-1969 ' Allowable deviations for dimensions without specified tolerances ( first revision ) \ 

6. Workmanship and Finish 

6.1 The thread handling areas of bobbins shall be free from sharp edges and burrs. 

6.2 The sliding part of bobbin in bobbin case shall be finished smooth. 

6.3 The bobbins shall be nickel plated to service Grade No. 2 of IS: 1068-1968 ( Specification for 
electroplated coatings of nickel and chromium on iron and steel (first revision)' and shall have 
bright finish and shall be free from blisters, pits, cloudy patches, cracks, strains and other defects. 

7. Packing — Each bobbin shall be wrapped in vapour-phase inhibitor paper ( commonly known as 
VPI paper) or given an anticorrosive treatment. The bobbins shall then be securely packed in 
strong cardboard cartons in accordance with the best prevalent trade practice. A carton shall 
consist of 200 bobbins unless specified otherwise by the purchaser. 



Adopted 11 August 1978

IS: 8892 -1978 

8. Marking — Each carton containing bobbins shall be marked with the manufacturer's name, 
discription of contents and/or trade-mark. 

8.1 ISI Certification Marking — Details available with the Indian Standards Institution. 



EXPLANATORY NOTE 

While preparing this standard assistance has been derived from JIS B 9073-1964 Bobbins of 
sewing machines for industrial use, issued by the Japanese Industrial Standards Committee.
